query: Consider CBP's Non-Disclosure Agreement; Does the document mention that some obligations of the Agreement may survive the termination of the Agreement?
gold: 11. Unless and until I am released in writing by an authorized representative of the Department of Homeland Security (if permissible for the particular category of information), I understand that all conditions and obligations imposed upon me by this Agreement apply during the time that I am granted conditional access, and at all times thereafter.
rag_answer: Yes. The document states in Clause 11 that all conditions and obligations imposed by the Agreement apply “during the time that I am granted conditional access, and at all times thereafter,” unless the signer is released in writing by an authorized DHS representative. This indicates that obligations continue after access ends and may survive termination.

judge.gold_summary: 金标指出协议第11条规定：除非被DHS授权代表书面解除，协议施加的所有条件和义务在获得有条件访问期间以及此后所有时间均适用。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答称第11条规定所有条件和义务在获得有条件访问期间及此后所有时间适用，除非被DHS授权代表书面解除，并据此说明义务可在访问结束后继续存续。
judge.reason: 系统回答准确覆盖了金标的关键条款、核心表述和例外条件，并正确回应了义务是否可能存续的问题。
